name: video-to-3d
title_zh: 单角色旋转视频进 Blender
tagline_zh: 别再手动描轮廓了。本地 MiniMax 生成缺失角度，数值化边缘拟合 + 融合校准，8-72 帧证据全用上。
tagline_en: Skip manual tracing. Local MiniMax fills missing angles, numerical silhouette fitting + fused calibration uses.
desc_en: Turn a single-character A-pose orbit video or an approved whole multi-view character sheet into an editable Blender model using local MiniMax H3 MAIN/H3 IR generation when needed, measured 8-72 angle evidence, calibrated Blender overlays, numerical per-angle silhouette-edge fitting, fused mask/scale/color refinement, and final 3D/beauty review. Use for fixed-subject character turntables and Blende
why_zh: 它把视频当测量数据，逐角度做边缘拟合，再用掩膜/缩放/颜色融合校准，比单张重建稳得多。
why_en: Treats video as measurement data—per-angle edge fitting plus mask/scale/color fusion beats single-image reconstruction.
limit_zh: 只认固定主体的角色旋转视频（A-pose 或已批准的多视图设定稿）；需本地 MiniMax H3 模型。
limit_en: Only fixed-subject character turntables (A-pose or approved multi-view sheets); requires local MiniMax H3; outputs Blender model only, no rigging.
title_en: Turn a character turntable video into an editable Blender.
